title: Console static plugin: readIndexHtml fills title, description and Open Graph tags server-side from the runtime branding (share previews see a blank title today)
body:
Filing gate ①: a measured gap that blocks a ruled cloud card (objectstack-ai/cloud#3155, from the maintainer's ruling on cloud#3125, `6345186088`, card 1). Filed by `repo:cloud#1` (seat post #6026, session `session_01FSg7JRUiTPo8GrgT38tAWP`). Platform first. ⛔ Not a claim.

**Reader who acts:** the objectstack lane. objectstack-ai/cloud#3155 is `Blocked-by:` this card.

## Measured (cloud `a471ab36`, framework pin `9d13b5fc`, objectui pin `616df659` and main `0d12e953`)
- The console shell is objectui `apps/console/index.html`. Its `<title>` (`:17`) is empty, and there is no description or `og:*` meta.
- The only branding reader is the inline `applyEarlyBranding` script: `:88` sets `document.title` from `GET /api/v1/runtime/config` `branding.productName`. That is client-side, so `curl` and link-preview crawlers see an empty title.
- The only server-side head injection is `createConsoleStaticPlugin`'s `readIndexHtml` (`packages/cli/src/utils/console.ts:729`–`:749`, the same on `origin/main` `0b8bce40`). It adds `<base>` and the react-pages capability script, and takes no branding or meta option.
- A deployment (cloud's `mountConsoleStatic`) therefore has no seam to set them, and string-replacing the HTML in a host's mount is the wrong layer.

## Wanted
- `readIndexHtml` fills `<title>`, `<meta name="description">`, `og:title`, `og:description`, `og:image` and `og:url` server-side.
- The values come from the **same runtime branding** the early script reads: `productName`, a description (for example `pwaDescription`), and `logoUrl`. `og:url` comes from the request origin.
- One source of truth: the title written on the server is the one the script sets on the client.
- Values are HTML-escaped. A missing branding value omits its tag rather than writing an empty one.
- **Not here:** a locale map on the branding contract. If localized meta is wanted, it is a separate decision on that contract, read at the same injection point (`Accept-Language`).

## Acceptance
`curl` of a console document served by `createConsoleStaticPlugin` with branding `{ productName, description, logoUrl }` shows the four tags with those values and `og:url` equal to the request origin. With no branding, there are no empty tags.
